test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

She is given proper guidance by her boss.

options.text: Her boss will give her proper guidance.
Her boss has given her proper guidance.
Her boss gave her proper guidance.
Her boss gives her proper guidance.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Her boss gives her proper guidance**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Passive Voice Structure**: Subject + Form of "to be" + Past Participle + Agent (optional)__
 
• Active Voic
